sourceEvidence.title: Operations Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
We are seeking an experienced Operations Manager with high-pressure die casting (HPDC) knowledge and demonstrated manufacturing leadership. This role will establish operational readiness during startup and then lead safe, reliable, and cost-effective daily operations across development trials, prototype builds, and production programs as they are introduced.

The role reports to the senior leader responsible for the center and directly supervises assigned production supervisors, operators, and technicians. It coordinates with Engineering, Plant Management, Maintenance, HR and Supply Chain to deliver agreed schedules and operating targets.
